dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Next question. What will have changed by 2050? Nam?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɛkst ˈkwɛstʃən. ˈwʌt wɪl hæv ˈtʃeɪndʒd baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti? ˈnɑːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By 2050, artificial intelligence will have changed almost every job.
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti, ˌɑːrtɪˈfɪʃəl ɪnˈtɛlɪdʒəns wɪl hæv ˈtʃeɪndʒd ˈɔːlmoʊst ˈɛvri ˈdʒɑːb.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you think that's good or bad?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk ðæts ˈɡʊd ɔːr ˈbæd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Both. But I hope doctors will have found a cure for many diseases by then.
dialogue.reading: ˈboʊθ. bʌt aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈdɑːktərz wɪl hæv ˈfaʊnd ə ˈkjʊr fər ˈmɛni dɪˈziːzɪz baɪ ˈðɛn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I hope so, too. What about transportation?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈhoʊp ˈsoʊ, ˈtuː. ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˌtrænspərˈteɪʃən?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By then, people will have stopped driving. Self-driving cars will do it for us!
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈðɛn, ˈpiːpəl wɪl hæv ˈstɑːpt ˈdraɪvɪŋ. ˌsɛlf ˈdraɪvɪŋ ˈkɑːrz wɪl ˈduː ɪt fər ˈʌs!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! And will we have started traveling to other planets?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! ənd wɪl wiː hæv ˈstɑːrtɪd ˈtrævəlɪŋ tə ˈʌðər ˈplænɪts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. Space travel will have become cheaper, but I still won't be able to afford it!
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ˈspeɪs ˌtrævəl wɪl hæv bɪˈkʌm ˈtʃiːpər, bʌt aɪ ˈstɪl ˈwoʊnt bi ˈeɪbəl tə əˈfɔːrd ɪt!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What about free time? How will we spend it?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt əˈbaʊt ˈfriː ˈtaɪm? ˈhaʊ wɪl wiː ˈspɛnd ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Probably in virtual reality. We'll travel the world from our sofas!
dialogue.reading: ˈprɑːbəbli ɪn ˈvɜːrtʃuəl riˈæləti. wiːl ˈtrævəl ðə ˈwɜːrld frəm aʊər ˈsoʊfəz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That sounds a bit sad to me.
dialogue.reading: ðæt ˈsaʊndz ə ˈbɪt ˈsæd tə ˈmiː.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Don't worry. By 2050, we'll have learned when to turn our devices off!
dialogue.reading: ˈdoʊnt ˈwɜːri. baɪ ˈtwɛnti ˈfɪfti, wiːl hæv ˈlɜːrnd wɛn tə ˈtɜːrn aʊər dɪˈvaɪsɪz ˈɔːf!
